meta.title: Rinnai series aliases
meta.notes: Marketing ↔ chassis / document keys for model pin + typeahead. Confirmed: HD28e↔VCM2837WC; HD28i↔VCM2837FFC/FFUC; Infinity 28↔VCM2837FF (not FFC); Solar 28 booster↔VCM2837FF S28*; no umbrella HD28 pin (RSP-75). AU HD200e↔VRM2632WC; HD200i↔REU-VR2632FFUG / REU-VRM2632FFUC; Infinity 26 external↔AM2626WD/WDL (owns Infinity 26 / INF26 / AM2626); Infinity 26 internal↔INF26I/FFUG; Infinity 26 Plus↔REUV2630WD/VRM2630WD; Infinity 26 Smartstart↔VR2626WGP; Infinity 32 Enviro↔KM3237WD; HD210e↔N3237WC; HD210i↔N3237FFC; Infinity 32 Enviro+↔N3237W (not all N3237). Commercial CF: HD32↔AM3237WC; HDC32↔NB3237; HDC211↔KM3237WDC/FFUDC; HD250e↔VRM3237WC; alias commercial on HD/HDC series. NZ discontinued REU-VM2630WC / HD200e Infinity removed from typeahead (Beau). RSP-95: +17 Hot Water series (Hotflo/Efinity/heat pump/solar/commercial matched-only). RSP-115: Demand Duo split into accessory families ddups/ddtstat/dduvc (not chassis). Weekend RR: +Infinity B (BM chassis) Pin1 series. Weekend RR: +EnviroSmart (K2430WG) Pin1 series.

series.label: HD28e
series.notes: HD28 external (WC). Pin 1 = Heavy Duty 28 External. Bare HD28 typeahead alias only — match stays HD28E* / VCM2837WC. Infinity 28 (FF) and Solar 28 (S28*) excluded.

series.label: HD28i
series.notes: HD28 internal (FFC/FFUC). Pin 1 = Heavy Duty 28 Internal. Do not swallow Infinity 28 VCM2837FF or Solar 28 S28*.

series.label: Infinity 28
series.notes: Infinity 28 internal FF (INF28* → REU-VCM2837FF-*). Distinct from HD28i FFC/FFUC and Solar 28 S28* boosters on the same FF chassis packing.

series.label: Solar 28
series.notes: Solar Infinity booster 28 INT (S28I*) on REU-VCM2837FF-70-*. Kept out of HD28 and Infinity 28 pins.

series.label: HD200e
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: REU-VRM2632WC / VRM2632WC = current AU HD200e external (EDPL also shows WC-AK). NZ discontinued REU-VM2630WC / HD200e Infinity is not linked here. Do not merge FFUC↔WC.

series.label: HD200i
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: HD200i ↔ REU-VR2632FFUG / REU-VRM2632FFUC (Infinity internal / FFUC). Aliases + documentKeys include FFUG mates for typeahead/docs; model pin match stays HD200I*/FFUC so INF26 is not swallowed. relatedFamilies flags wider FFU heritage for later cross-family parts search.

series.label: Infinity 26
series.notes: Active AU Infinity 26 external / Touch (AM2626WD / AM2626WDL). Owns bare Infinity 26 / INF26 / AM2626 typeahead. Heritage VR2626WG via INF26L/N/B marketing or chassis Item Number (incl. K26*); heritage Enviro KM2635WD via chassis. Smartstart WGP stays out (unit class WGP ≠ WG). INF26I/P/S stay out. Smaller A/AM sizes live under Infinity A.

series.label: Infinity A
series.notes: AU Infinity A family (REU-AM1220WD / AM1620WD / AM2024WD + A1620WB / A2024WB / A2626WB + solar A*WS). Pin match is chassis Item Number only — marketing INF12/16/20*MA and B16/B20/B26*A collide with VR/BM prefixes. AM2626WD/WDL owned by Infinity 26. Cover-true SM: New A Series CF Parts List; PL: HW_CF_A_Series_Parts_List_Issue_1_Jan_2018.

series.label: Infinity 26 (internal)
series.notes: Infinity 26 internal FFUG (INF26I* + S26I*70 solar on VR2632FFUG) — SM pairing with HD200i FFUC. Bare Infinity 26 / INF26 owned by infinity26 external. S26L/N/B external solar (VR2426WS) stay on B24 pin.

series.label: Infinity 26 Internal (V2632FFU)
series.notes: Heritage Infinity 26 internal on REU-V2632FFU (INF26IL/IN without temp suffix codes). Unit class FFU so FFUG/FFUC stay on Infinity 26 internal / HD200i. Cover-true SM: SM V26FFU.pdf (also lists HD200i V2632FFUC).

series.label: Infinity 26 Plus
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: REUV2630WD / VRM2630WD → Infinity 26 Plus. Bare INF26 owned by infinity26 external.

series.label: Infinity 26 Smartstart
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: VR2626WGP → Infinity 26 Smartstart. Bare INF26 owned by infinity26 external.

series.label: Infinity B
series.notes: AU Infinity B family (REU-BM1220W / BM1620W / BM2024W / BM2626W + solar BM1620WS / BM2626WS). Pin match is chassis Item Number only — marketing INF12/16/20/26*B codes collide with AM/heritage INF prefixes so they are not used as prefixes. Bare B26 typeahead alias avoided (heritage A2626/VR2626WB). Cover-true SM: HW_CF_BM_SM BM2626 & B26 Series; PL: 2025 BM SERIES Infinity B Issue 1. Heritage B24 on VR2426WB is a separate pin (vr2426).

series.label: B24
series.notes: Heritage AU B24 / solar booster on REU-VR2426WB / VR2426WS (marketing B24* + S26*70). Pin match is chassis Item Number only — do not swallow VR2626WG (Infinity 26) or BM B-series. Cover-true SM: SMVR2426W_VR2632WC.pdf; PL: EDPL VR2426_VR2626.pdf / EDPL B24.pdf.

series.label: Infinity 16
series.notes: Heritage AU Infinity 16 on REU-VR1620WG / WB / WS (INF16* + B16* + S20* solar booster). Pin match is chassis Item Number only — marketing INF16* collides with AM1620 / BM1620 / VRM1620. Cover-true SM: smvREUVR1616W_VR2024_v2.pdf; PL: EDPL VR1620.pdf. Not Infinity B (BM) or Infinity A (AM).

series.label: Infinity 20
series.notes: Heritage AU Infinity 20 on REU-VR2024WG (INF20*). Pin match is chassis Item Number only — marketing INF20* collides with AM2024 / BM2024. VR2024WB excluded (not on cover-true SM). Cover-true SM: smvREUVR1616W_VR2024_v2.pdf (shared with Infinity 16); PL: EDPL VR2024.pdf.

series.label: Infinity 16 (V)
series.notes: Pre-VR Infinity 16 on REU-V1620WG/WB/WS. Chassis-only match so VR1620 / AM / BM stay on their pins. Cover-true SM: smv1616W.pdf (shared with Infinity 20 (V)); PL: EDPL REUV1620WG.pdf.

series.label: Infinity 20 (V)
series.notes: Pre-VR Infinity 20 on REU-V2024WG. Chassis-only match. Cover-true SM: smv1616W.pdf (shared with Infinity 16 (V)); PL: EDPL REUV2024WG.pdf.

series.label: Infinity 16/18/20 (V1616)
series.notes: Early Infinity 16/18/20 on REU-V1616W / V2018W / V2020W. Chassis fragments avoid V1616WF bleed (V1616WAK not bare V1616W). Does NOT include V1620WG/V2024WG (separate pin). Cover-true SM: SM V16_18_20.pdf; PL: EDPL V1616W_2018W_2020W.pdf.

series.label: V3232
series.notes: Heritage Infinity 32 on REU-V3232W (INF32A*). Chassis fragments use V3232WAK so V3232WC (HD250AL) stays on HD250e. Cover-true SM: SM V32.pdf; PL: EDPL V3232W_WC.pdf. Not modern HD32/AM3237.

series.label: EnviroSmart
series.notes: AU EnviroSmart continuous-flow (REU-K2430WG). Marketing ENVSMT*. Cover-true SM smK2430WAK.pdf; PL EDPL REU-K2430WG.pdf. K2403 PDF on disk is a misnamed K2430 sheet — not a separate series.

series.label: Infinity 32
series.notes: AU Infinity 32 external on REU-VR3237WG (INF32*). Chassis-only match so AM3237 / KM3237 / N3237 / VRM3237WG stay out. Cover-true SM: smVR3237WG_WC.pdf (shared with HD250e VRM3237WC); PL: EDPL VR_VRM3237 / EDPLVRM3237 Issue 4 / REU-V3237WG Parts List. Solar VR3237WS and VRM3237WG not on SM cover.

series.label: V3237
series.notes: Heritage Infinity 32 / HD250 predecessor on REU-V3237WG. Chassis-only so VR3237WG (Infinity 32) and VRM3237 stay out. Cover-true SM: smREUV3237W_VM3237WC April09.pdf; PL: EDPL REUV3237.pdf.

series.label: Infinity 20 Internal (2006)
series.notes: Heritage Infinity 20 internal on REU-2006FFU (INF20IN). Cover-true SM: SM 2006.pdf + SM-embedded PL/ED pages. Chassis-only so modern Infinity 20 VR2024 stays out.

series.label: Infinity 24 (2402)
series.notes: Heritage Infinity 24 Litre Series on REU-2402W / REU-2402FFU (INF24PIL/PIN). Cover-true SM: SM 2402.pdf (cover lists both). Not REU-24WA.

series.label: Infinity 24 WA
series.notes: Heritage Infinity REU-24 W-A (INF24L50 / REU-24WANCL-50). Cover-true SM: SM 24WA.pdf + SM-embedded PL/ED pages. Chassis fragment 24WA so 2402 stays on infinity24-2402.

series.label: Infinity 32 (3203)
series.notes: Heritage Infinity high-capacity on REU-3203W (INF32NA). Cover-true SM: SM REU3203.pdf + SM-embedded PL/ED pages. Not V3232 / VR3237 / AM3237.

series.label: V2626
series.notes: Heritage Infinity on REU-V2626W (not WG/WR). Chassis fragments use V2626WAK so V2626WG/WR stay on Infinity 26. Cover-true SM: SM V26.pdf (also lists HD200e V2632WC — those stay on hd200e). PL: EDPL REUV2626W_REUV2632WC.pdf.

series.label: Smartstart
series.notes: Smartstart CUG1 preheat accessory (marketing SMARTSTART). Cover-true SM: SM Smartstart.pdf; PL: EDPL Smartstart.pdf. Not Infinity 26 Smartstart inbuilt (VR2626WGP).

series.label: Infinity 16 (VRM1620)
series.notes: Mid-gen Infinity 16 on REU-VRM1620WG (INF16*M). Chassis-only so VR1620 / BM1620 stay out. Local PL/ED family diagrams on REU-VRM2024.pdf (exploded pages label VRM1620W/VRM2024W/VRM2626W-AK; list columns are VRM2024WG). Cover-true SM: VRM16/VRM20 Issue 03 (shared with vrm2024).

series.label: Infinity 20 (VRM2024)
series.notes: Mid-gen Infinity 20 on REU-VRM2024WG (INF20*M). Chassis-only so VR2024WG (Infinity 20) and VR2024WB stay out. Local PL: REU-VRM2024.pdf (family exploded pages also label VRM1620/VRM2626). Cover-true SM: VRM16/VRM20 Issue 03 (shared with vrm1620).

series.label: Infinity 26 (VRM2626 K26)
series.notes: K26 mid-gen REU-VRM2626WG-*-2 only (K26L60M/K26N60M). INF26*M VRM2626WG rows stay on Infinity 26 marketing until a cover-true SM split. Local PL/ED family diagrams on REU-VRM2024.pdf. Cover-true SM: VR2626WB_VRM2626WG Issue 03 (also covers B26/S26 chassis — those series keep their own packs).

series.label: Infinity 32 (VRM3237WG)
series.notes: Mid-gen Infinity 32 on REU-VRM3237WG (INF32*M). Chassis-only so VR3237WG (Infinity 32) and VRM3237WC (HD250e) stay out. Local PL headers on EDPL VR_VRM3237 / EDPLVRM3237 Issue 4. Cover-true SM: VR3237WG/VRM3237WG/VRM3237WC Issue 03 (hd250e/infinity32 keep sm-vr3237wg-wc).

series.label: B20 (VR2024WB)
series.notes: Heritage B20 on REU-VR2024WB. Chassis-only so VR2024WG (Infinity 20) stays out. Bare B20 typeahead stays on Infinity B (BM). Local PL: VR2024WB-50-AK B20 NON50.pdf. No cover-true SM on disk (excluded from smvREUVR1616W_VR2024_v2).

series.label: Infinity 32 Enviro
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: KM3237WD → Infinity 32 Enviro / Enviro Plus (incl. NZ INF32EEL/EEN). Match is KM3237WD only (not WDC/FFUDC HDC211, not FFUD INF32EIL/EIN, not N3237 Enviro+/HD210).

series.label: HD210e
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: N3237WC → HD210e. Shared N3237 platform with HD210i / Enviro+ — keep badges distinct; do not map all N3237 to Infinity 32 Enviro Plus.

series.label: HD210i
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: N3237FFC → HD210i. Distinct from N3237WC (HD210e) and N3237W (Infinity 32 Enviro+).

series.label: Infinity 32 Enviro+
series.notes: Confirmed Beau: N3237W → Infinity 32 Enviro+. Item match is N3237WD / specific N3237W60AK* only — never REUN3237W prefix (would swallow WC/FFC HD210).

series.label: HD32e
series.notes: Commercial HD32e ↔ REU-AM3237WC only. Do not use bare AM3237 (swallows Infinity 32 AM3237W and solar AM3237WS).

series.label: HDC32e
series.notes: Tech ingest: HDC32 external ↔ NB3237WC. Shared NB PL also tagged for internal.

series.label: HDC32i
series.notes: Tech ingest: HDC32 internal ↔ NB3237FFC.

series.label: HDC211e
series.notes: Commercial HDC211 external ↔ KM3237WDC (not KM3237WD Infinity 32 Enviro). PL Pin1: REU-KM3237WDC-AK Combined SP & EPD SEP 2018 (cover HDC211e).

series.label: HDC211i
series.notes: Commercial HDC211 internal ↔ KM3237FFUDC.

series.label: HD250e
series.notes: Tech ingest: HD250e ↔ VRM3237WC (plus older V3232WC heritage on some SKUs).

series.label: Flowmaster FM10
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: Flowmaster FM10LA/NA. Continuous-flow instantaneous; not Hotflo storage. No REU unit class. Cover-true SM IHF10.pdf (TO SUIT MODEL IHF10) + IHF10-Spare-Parts-List.pdf Issue 3 — same chassis as Hotflo IHF10 / DI Flowmaster FM10–IHF10 PLs.

series.label: Efinity ECF
series.notes: RSP-95 + Tech Issue 4: Efinity ECF14/19/29 Issue PLs (ECF14 I50/I60 shared PDF). One series, chassis-scoped stems. Cover-true SM: ECF Efinity Electric CFHW Issue 3.

series.label: Hotflo EHFA160
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHFA160S* → PL Hotflo EHFA160. Proof part 95110104 (ELEMENT 2.4KW EHFA160). No REU chassis.

series.label: Hotflo EHFD160
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHFD160S* → PL Hotflo EHFD160.

series.label: Hotflo EHFA250
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHFA250S24/36 → EHFA SPARE PARTS.pdf; S48 → EHF 250SL 315L PL. Slim add-on: HFE 250S 315S SPL Issue 8. documentKeys include EHFA for shared desktop sheet.

series.label: Hotflo EHFA315
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHFA315S* → PL Hotflo EHF 250SL 315L. Slim add-on: HFE 250S 315S SPL Issue 8.

series.label: Hotflo EHFA400
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHFA400S* → PL Hotflo EHFA 400L.

series.label: Hotflo EHF25
series.notes: RSP-95 + Tech Issue 9: EHF25 → HFE 25L 50L PL. Exclude EHFA/EHFD/EHP* prefixes so storage siblings stay distinct.

series.label: Hotflo GHF4
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: GHF4135* → PL Hotflo GHF4 135L/170L.

series.label: Heat Pump AR EHPA
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHPA300/340 VM* → AR series PL.

series.label: Enviroflo VMA
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHPA250VMA/H → Enviroflo VMA V2 PL.

series.label: Heat Pump GR EHPG
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHPGxxVM → GR series SPL/SM.

series.label: Heat Pump A EHPT
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHPT180VM → A series heat pump SM.

series.label: Heat Pump B/E EHPS
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: EHPS215VM → B/E series heat pump SM.

series.label: Solar Split SG
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: SGxxx(A) solar split PLs. Matched-only — no invented SE links.

series.label: Commercial Heat Pump CHP
series.notes: RSP-95 matched: CHP020H/CHP040H → commercial heat pump SM.

series.label: DDUPS
series.notes: RSP-115/123: Demand Duo accessory family — Grundfos circulation pumps (not chassis). Trailing N on DDUPS/DDUPM = stainless body (not Nat Gas). Pin3 Item Number shows that SKU card only.

series.label: DDTSTAT
series.notes: RSP-115: Demand Duo accessory family — pump controllers (DD56TSTAT for DD combo 5 & 6 / cascading). Not chassis / Pin3.

series.label: UVC / DDUVC
series.notes: RSP-115: Demand Duo accessory family — UV sterilisation (DDUVC finished goods + UVC spares). Not chassis / Pin3.
